designationHistory.indexText: Shiawassee National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1953 near Saginaw, Michigan, to provide habitat for migratory waterfowl.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act (presumed; not verified)

designationHistory.note: FWS-only source for the year. The establishing authority and exact date were not found; the FWS Realty "refuge purpose" sheet exists in ServCat but was not read in full. Needs a Migratory Bird Conservation Commission report or a 1953 Michigan newspaper.
